title: Source file list
responsibility: Renders source file rows with optional external links and a supplied per-file action.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.files
inputs.description: Paths are rendered in array order, one row per entry; an empty array selects the empty state. Each complete path is passed unchanged to href and children.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.label
inputs.description: Accessible name assigned to the rendered list when files is non-empty. Defaults to the literal string Source files; it is unused in the empty state.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.empty
inputs.default: No source files recorded at this revision.
inputs.description: Message rendered through EmptyState only when files is empty; otherwise it is unused. Defaults to the literal string No source files recorded at this revision.
examples: No source files recorded at this revision.
No files changed in this revision.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.relativeTo
inputs.description: Passed with each path to sourceFileParts to derive the displayed folder and name; it does not change the path passed to href or children or the path used for title text. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.href
inputs.description: Called once for each path when files is non-empty, with the complete path; a truthy returned string is used directly as the link destination, while undefined or an empty string renders plain code text. The return value is not validated as a URL.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.children
inputs.description: Svelte snippet rendered once in each file row and given the complete path; it is not rendered when files is empty.

outputs.name: SourceFileList
outputs.description: Renders one row per path in order with folder/name text, a complete-path title, and the matching children snippet; a truthy href(path) result makes the text an underlined new-tab link with the complete path as its accessible label, while a falsy result makes it code text. An empty array renders empty through EmptyState; paths wrap at widths up to 800px and rows use one column at widths up to 480px.

errors.name: Caller callback or snippet error
errors.description: If href(path) or the rendered children snippet throws, SourceFileList lets that exception propagate because it does not catch either call.
